notes:
Driver for the IKA RET control-visc hotplate stirrer in the clone's Stirrer/ directory, native Stirrer.IKA_RET_Control_Visc:IKARETControlVisc (one of the card's entry symbols). It is a direct Driver with a native.py factory because the upstream assembles the IKA command lines from parts. The package is model-authored and unreviewed, so the hardware backend was never run; the fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording, and the evidence is contract_checked only. The clone's SerialDevice raises OSError on a non-Windows system (Stirrer/serial_labware/serial_labware.py:104-108), so the hardware path can only open a port on Windows and the card's linux platform was not exercised. The card's safety.limit_hints point at doosan-robot files for the robot arm in the same repository, not at the hotplate; they were not used. The 340 Cel and 0 to 1700 rpm limits come from the hotplate wrapper (Stirrer/hotplate.py:45 and :69). The hint methods set_watch_dog_temp, set_watch_dog_stir_rate, get_hot_plate_temp_current and get_viscosity_trend are empty methods upstream (Stirrer/IKA_RET_Control_Visc.py:264-276) and are not exposed; the reads use the real property/getter methods instead. The weight value has no unit in the clone and is exposed as a unitless number. The hint classes cap.measure.temperature.v1, cap.measure.mass.v1 and cap.sensing.read.v1 do not bind device_kind thermal.zone, so temperature and mass are state reads and the only catalogued action is cap.thermal.setpoint.v1; the heater, stirrer, pH-meter, weighing, RESET and combined safe-state commands are x-cap extensions. No line of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so SAFE-045 is met by the safe_state action x-cap.kist-csrc.stop_heating_and_stirring.v1 (STOP_1 and STOP_4), which is also the @estop path. NOT COVERED: no array-valued data exists on this interface and the upstream's unused name/software_version/watchdog and viscosity members are not exposed. The gate passed with no warnings.

catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class switches a thermal zone's heater on or off; cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 only writes a target temperature
no catalogue class covers a magnetic hotplate stirrer; cap.fluid.mix.v1 binds liquid handlers and pipettes and requires a well target
the catalogue has no pH capability class (catalog search ph returns no class)
cap.measure.mass.v1 is a measurement read for balance and sensor kinds, not a start/stop command on a thermal zone
cap.world.reset.v1 resets a simulated world (world.sim) and cannot express the hot plate's native RESET command
cap.motion.stop.v1 and cap.motion.estop.v1 bind robot arms, mobile bases and motion axes, not a thermal zone, and no class stops a heater and a stirrer together
